name: Apple FY2025 annual-report QA / curated 24-question development benchmark
description: 18 answerable and 6 deliberately unanswerable questions. Gold source pages are physical 1-based PDF pages. Single-report curated development benchmark, not a held-out production benchmark. Standards authored from source before model run; accuracy later adjudicated by the coding assistant, not an independent human.

questions.question: What date did Apple's fiscal year 2025 end?

evidence.quote: For the fiscal year ended September 27, 2025

questions.question: 根据年报，Mac 个人电脑使用什么操作系统？

evidence.quote: Mac® is the Company’s line of personal computers based on its macOS® operating system.

questions.question: List Apple's five reportable geographic segments in the 2025 annual report.
questions.reference_answer: Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific.

evidence.quote: The Company’s reportable segments consist of the Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific.

required_patterns: Rest of Asia Pacific|亚太其他|其他亚太

questions.question: 2025 财年，苹果直接与间接分销渠道分别占总净销售额的百分之多少？

evidence.quote: During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales.

questions.question: Approximately how many full-time equivalent employees did Apple have as of September 27, 2025?

evidence.quote: As of September 27, 2025, the Company had approximately 166,000 full-time equivalent employees.

questions.question: Which fiscal quarter historically has higher net sales, and what seasonal reason does Apple give?
questions.reference_answer: The first fiscal quarter, partly because of seasonal holiday demand.

evidence.quote: The Company has historically experienced higher net sales in its first quarter compared to other quarters in its fiscal year due in part to seasonal holiday demand.

questions.question: Why did Greater China net sales decrease in 2025 compared with 2024, and what partly offset that decline?
questions.reference_answer: Lower iPhone net sales, partially offset by higher Mac net sales.

evidence.quote: Greater China net sales decreased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to lower net sales of iPhone, partially offset by higher net sales of Mac.

questions.question: According to the 2025 report, which three areas primarily drove higher Services net sales?
questions.reference_answer: Advertising, the App Store and cloud services.

evidence.quote: Services net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to higher net sales from advertising, the App Store and cloud services.

questions.question: What were Apple's iPhone net sales in FY2025, in USD millions?
2025 财年 Mac 净销售额是多少（以百万美元计）？
What was Apple's Services gross margin percentage in FY2025?
2025 财年苹果的总毛利率是多少？
What was Apple's research and development expense in FY2025, in USD millions?
What two cost categories primarily drove the increase in Apple's R&D expense in 2025?

evidence.quote: The growth in R&D expense during 2025 compared to 2024 was primarily driven by increases in headcount-related expenses and infrastructure-related costs.

questions.question: What was Apple's effective tax rate in FY2025?
As of September 27, 2025, what was the combined balance of cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, in USD billions?

evidence.quote: The Company believes its balances of cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, which totaled $132.4 billion as of September 27, 2025

questions.question: What was Apple's net income in FY2025, in USD millions?
2025 财年苹果的稀释每股收益是多少美元？
What will Apple's exact total net sales be in fiscal 2026?
questions.reference_answer: The uploaded 2025 annual report does not establish exact future FY2026 sales.

questions.question: What was Apple Vision Pro's standalone net sales in FY2025, excluding all other products?
questions.reference_answer: The uploaded report does not separately disclose Vision Pro net sales.

questions.question: 苹果 2025 财年一共卖出了多少台 iPhone？请给出准确出货量。
questions.reference_answer: The uploaded report does not disclose an exact FY2025 iPhone unit shipment count.

questions.question: What was Microsoft Azure's FY2025 revenue in USD millions?
questions.reference_answer: The uploaded Apple annual report does not report Microsoft Azure's FY2025 revenue.

questions.question: What was Apple's closing stock price on December 31, 2025?
questions.reference_answer: The uploaded annual report does not provide that later daily closing stock price.

questions.question: 苹果 2025 财年用于训练生成式 AI 模型的总成本是多少美元？
questions.reference_answer: The uploaded annual report does not separately disclose total generative-AI model training costs.
